steps.action: C32 add Officer, reject an earlier resignation, retain a valid resignation in Show former
steps.actual: Officer name, role, appointment and optional user link saved; earlier resignation was visibly refused and saved date unchanged; valid resignation hid the current row and Show former recovered the retained appointment

steps.action: C32 create and edit Registration without changing the formation jurisdiction
steps.actual: Additional Delaware Registration saved number and agent; Lapsed selection persisted while formation jurisdiction remained England and Wales

steps.action: C32 Holding directions, percentage edit and over-100 aggregate warning preserve both Entities
steps.actual: Owner direction appeared reciprocally on both Entity records; percentage edit saved 85; adding a second 30 percent owner warned at 115 percent while retaining both Holdings and all Entities

steps.action: C32 ownership loops, duplicate Holdings, self ownership and invalid percentages are refused
steps.actual: A separate API fixture supplied an indirect ownership path; the browser refused the resulting loop with its message. Direct duplicate Holding returned 409; self-ownership and out-of-range percentage returned 400; the two existing Holdings remained unchanged

steps.action: C32 upload an Entity-owned Document with no seeded folder and download its original bytes
steps.actual: Fresh Entity had no folders; shared Upload created its owned v1 Document; reader opened and browser original download matched uploaded PDF bytes

steps.action: C32 archive a populated Entity, verify child edits refused, and restore the preserved corporate facts
steps.actual: Archive hid child-create controls and refused Registration edit; restoration retained Officer resignation, both Holdings, Registration and uploaded Document and returned controls
